name: com.storetechscan/storetechscan
title: StoreTechScan — Ecommerce & Website Tech Stack API
description: Website tech stack + passive DNS, product prices & AI fit. 25 one-time trial.

tools.name: inspect_domains
tools.description: Live 4-stage enrichment for 1–25 unique domains per call: detects ecommerce platforms & marketing/support/pixel stack (Shopify, WooCommerce, Klaviyo, Gorgias, Recharge, Meta/TikTok Pixel, GA4), samples public Shopify /products.json catalog counts & native-currency min/median/max prices, scores 1.0–5.0 ICP prospect fit + active-merchant check + wholesale/B2B signal, and extracts public same-domain role emails (hello@, sales@) & social URLs. Pass multiple domains together in one array rather than calling 1 domain at a time. Paid mode (via HTTP header Authorization: Bearer zsk_live_... or X-API-Key) debits 1 credit per reachable billable domain ($0 for DNS/TLS/timeout/5xx/429/WAF failures), enables calibrated AI ICP scoring, and returns a durable job_id recoverable via get_inspection_results.

oneOf.description: Array of 1 to 25 domains or URLs (batch multiple domains together in a single call).
Newline- or comma-separated list of 1 to 25 domains or URLs.

real_merchant_only.description: Optional filter: return only verified active merchants/operators (excludes parked/empty stores).

b2b_wholesale_only.description: Optional filter: return only domains with detected B2B, trade, or wholesale signals.

min_fit_score.description: Optional filter: minimum 1.0–5.0 ICP prospect fit score (e.g. 3.5 or 4.0).

platform.description: Optional filter: match primary platform or detected tech (e.g. "Shopify", "WooCommerce", "Klaviyo").

profile.description: Optional inspection depth: ecommerce (default 4-stage ecommerce enrichment), tech_stack (fast 200+ Web/SaaS fingerprints + passive MX/TXT/CNAME/NS DNS + evidence[]), or full (both).

include_evidence.description: Optional: return auditable detection evidence[] entries even on the default ecommerce profile.

tools.name: inspect_product_url
tools.description: Probe 1–10 public Shopify, WooCommerce, BigCommerce, or Schema.org DTC product URLs for live title, brand, native currency, price, compare-at price, variants, and explicit public available: true/false status. Unreachable, rate-limited, or WAF-blocked URLs return billable: false ($0). Paid mode (via HTTP header Authorization: Bearer zsk_live_... or X-API-Key) debits 1 credit per reachable billable domain ($0 for DNS/TLS/timeout/5xx/429/WAF failures), enables calibrated AI ICP scoring, and returns a durable job_id recoverable via get_inspection_results.

url.description: Single public product URL (use either url or urls).

urls.description: Array of 1 to 10 public product URLs.

tools.name: get_inspection_results
tools.description: Retrieve saved results for a previously submitted StoreTechScan job_id (from inspect_domains or web workspace) at 0 credit cost. Useful if a network connection dropped during an inspection.

job_id.description: The job_id (e.g. "job_...") returned by inspect_domains or check_credits.

tools.name: check_credits
tools.description: Check your StoreTechScan credit balance and recent ledger transactions (when authenticated via Authorization: Bearer or X-API-Key HTTP header), or view the anonymous one-time 25-domain free trial policy and pay-as-you-go pack pricing. Costs 0 credits.

tools.name: buy_credits
tools.description: Create a one-time credit pack checkout for a human to pay in their browser. Show only checkout_url to the human; keep session_id and claim_token with the agent and never put claim_token in a browser URL. After payment, poll claim_purchase every 10–15 seconds for up to 15 minutes. The API key appears only in the claim_purchase tool result, once with a 15-minute same-IP retry grace window. To top up an existing account, authenticate this MCP connection with its Bearer or X-API-Key header before calling.

tools.name: claim_purchase
tools.description: Poll a purchase created by buy_credits using the agent-held session_id and claim_token. While ready is false, wait retry_after_seconds before retrying (up to 15 minutes). Once the human has paid, returns the API key for the agent to store securely and use in the MCP connection or REST Authorization header. Keep the claim token out of the browser; key retrieval can be retried from the same IP for 15 minutes after the first successful claim.

tools.name: get_ecommerce_benchmark_2026
tools.description: Retrieve empirical benchmark findings across 235 deduplicated real storefronts comparing unpaced burst HTTP (29.4% reachability, 155 HTTP 429s) vs. paced inspection (92.8% reachability, 95.9% cohort consistency, 100% zero-drift native-currency price medians). Costs 0 credits.

format.description: Return structured JSON summary ("summary", default) or include raw CC BY 4.0 CSV ("csv").
